primitives.name: Bash Read-Only Constraint

primitives.assumptions: All operations are restricted to read-only Bash commands; no file modification allowed.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Constraint violation triggers operational halt or error state in execution.

layer2.mapping: Maps to GSE's constraint enforcement layer and GSI's action-space restriction logic.
layer2.telemetry: Command legality check, forbidden operation attempts, execution mode compliance.

reasoning_traces.think:
The Explore agent embodies a dual mathematical structure: a stochastic search kernel over file manifolds and a constrained traversal mechanism. The kernel is defined by a probabilistic map from query space (regex/glob) to file space, where each query induces a likelihood distribution over file excerpts. The traversal mechanism enforces a read-only constraint, modeled as a state transition function that maps current file context to next valid file excerpt. The kernel's efficiency depends on the cardinality of the file manifold and the specificity of the query. Failure modes include: 1) Excerpt window exclusion of target definitions, 2) Ambiguous glob patterns, 3) Regex insufficient context. These failures manifest as zero or spurious matches. The agent's design reflects a dual duality: it is both a search oracle (locating) and a constraint enforcer (read-only). Its epistemic closure is maintained through bounded information access, ensuring no synthesis beyond excerpted content.
